title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
title_zh: OpenMAP-HIE：用于无监督新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶分割的病理引导基于分数的扩散模型

paragraphs.en: 提出病理引导扩散模型OpenMAP-HIE，实现无监督新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶分割，性能接近监督模型。 Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic--ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. Based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE, only discrepancies consistent with the expected pathological direction are retained and aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. Spatial mean filtering further suppresses isolated responses. The framework was evaluated on the BONBID-HIE dataset. The ADC-only method achieved a Dice score of $0.283\pm0.244$, average precision of $0.505$, Hausdorff distance of $25.45\pm15.63$ mm, mean average surface distance of $9.40\pm8.49$ mm, and normalized surface distance of $0.355\pm0.236$, providing the best overlap and surface-distance performance among the evaluated unsupervised methods and Dice performance comparable to supervised ADC-only models. Optional population-derived ADC $Z$-map refinement further increased Dice to $0.602\pm0.269$. These findings support pathology-informed score discrepancies as a useful signal for neonatal HIE lesion localization, while highlighting remaining challenges in detecting small and low-contrast lesions.
paragraphs.zh: 提出病理引导的分数扩散模型OpenMAP-HIE，实现无监督新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶定位，性能接近监督模型。在表观扩散系数（ADC）图像上准确定位新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶具有重要的临床意义，但受限于专家标注稀缺以及病灶表现的显著变异性。 我们提出OpenMAP-HIE，一种病理引导的基于分数的扩散模型，可在无需体素级病灶监督的情况下实现无监督HIE病灶定位。 去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿ADC分布，而基于ControlNet的条件分支保留患者特异性解剖结构。 在推理阶段，异常证据直接来源于条件预测与无条件预测在独立评估的扩散噪声水平上的噪声预测差异，从而避免了对最终伪健康重建或顺序反向扩散链的依赖。 基于急性HIE特征性的ADC降低，仅保留与预期病理方向一致差异，并使用几何平均在不同噪声水平上进行聚合。 空间均值滤波进一步抑制孤立响应。 该框架在BONBID-HIE数据集上进行了评估。 仅使用ADC的方法取得了0.283±0.244的Dice分数、0.505的平均精度、25.45±15.63 mm的Hausdorff距离、9.40±8.49 mm的平均表面距离以及0.355±0.236的归一化表面距离，在所评估的无监督方法中提供了最佳的重叠和表面距离性能，其Dice性能与仅使用ADC的监督模型相当。 可选的基于人群的ADC Z图细化进一步将Dice提升至0.602±0.269。 这些发现支持将病理引导的分数差异作为新生儿HIE病灶定位的有用信号，同时也凸显了在检测小病灶和低对比度病灶方面仍存在的挑战。
